property_summary: For any callee address that reverts when called, C.forward returns (completes) with a failed call (i.e., the external call failing causes forward to revert under the reference) while the mutant inverts that logic so it incorrectly succeeds when the callee succeeds and reverts when the callee succeeds/fails oppositely; specifically: the reference propagates requirement that the low-level call succeeded, so try/catch on forward yields ok == true iff callee call succeeded — the mutant flips this, causing inverted ok for some inputs (a reverting vs non-reverting callee).
change_summary: Invert the require so it requires failure (revert when original succeeds), causing forward to revert on successful callee call but succeed when callee call fails (opposite behavior).
